# CWE-284: Improper Access Control — Detection in Infrastructure as Code

## Overview of Weakness Categories in IaC

---

## 1. Overly Permissive Identity & Access Management (IAM) Policies

**Description:** Policies that grant broader permissions than necessary, violating least-privilege principles.

| Keywords / Attributes / Fields | Risk Signal |
|---|---|
| `action: "*"` / `actions: ["*"]` | Wildcard granting all actions |
| `resource: "*"` / `resources: ["*"]` | Applies to all resources |
| `effect: allow` combined with wildcards | Unrestricted allow |
| `not_action`, `not_resource` | Inverse logic that may grant excess access |
| `administrator_access`, `full_access` | Overly broad managed policies |
| `inline_policy` with no conditions | Missing scoping conditions |
| `condition: {}` or absent `condition` | No contextual restrictions |
| `principal: "*"` | Any principal can assume/use |

---

## 2. Public Resource Exposure

**Description:** Resources are inadvertently made accessible to the public internet or anonymous users.

| Keywords / Attributes / Fields | Risk Signal |
|---|---|
| `publicly_accessible: true` | Database/service exposed publicly |
| `acl: public-read` / `acl: public-read-write` | Public object/bucket ACL |
| `block_public_acls: false` | Public ACLs not blocked |
| `block_public_policy: false` | Public bucket policies allowed |
| `restrict_public_buckets: false` | Buckets accessible without restriction |
| `ignore_public_acls: false` | Existing public ACLs honored |
| `website { }` block without access control | Public static website enabled |
| `enable_public_ip: true` / `associate_public_ip_address: true` | Instance directly internet-facing |
| `anonymous` / `allUsers` / `allAuthenticatedUsers` | Public identity principals |

---

## 3. Unrestricted Network Access (Security Groups / Firewall Rules)

**Description:** Firewall or security group rules that allow traffic from any source.

| Keywords / Attributes / Fields | Risk Signal |
|---|---|
| `cidr: 0.0.0.0/0` / `cidr: ::/0` | All IPv4/IPv6 sources allowed |
| `source_ranges: ["0.0.0.0/0"]` | Unrestricted ingress |
| `from_port: 0`, `to_port: 65535` | All ports open |
| `protocol: -1` / `protocol: all` | All traffic types permitted |
| `ingress` rules without source restriction | Open inbound rules |
| `egress` with unrestricted destination | Uncontrolled outbound traffic |
| `allow_all` / `deny_none` | Blanket allow rules |
| `direction: ingress` + `ports: []` | Missing port restriction |

---

## 4. Missing or Disabled Authentication Configuration

**Description:** Services or endpoints that do not require authentication.

| Keywords / Attributes / Fields | Risk Signal |
|---|---|
| `authorization_type: NONE` / `authorization: NONE` | No auth on API endpoint |
| `auth_type: none` | Authentication disabled |
| `require_auth: false` | Auth explicitly disabled |
| `authentication_enabled: false` | Auth turned off |
| `anonymous_auth_enabled: true` | Kubernetes anonymous access |
| `enable_key_based_auth: false` | No key-based access control |
| `api_key_required: false` | API key bypass allowed |
| `disable_auth: true` | Explicit auth bypass |
| Missing `authentication` block entirely | No auth configuration |

---

## 5. Excessive Privilege Role Assignments

**Description:** Roles or bindings that grant elevated or administrative privileges broadly.

| Keywords / Attributes / Fields | Risk Signal |
|---|---|
| `role: admin` / `role: owner` | High-privilege assignment |
| `cluster_role_binding` with broad subjects | All users/services bound to admin |
| `subjects: system:authenticated` | All authenticated users |
| `subjects: system:unauthenticated` | Unauthenticated users granted access |
| `verbs: ["*"]` | All Kubernetes API verbs |
| `kind: ClusterRole` with wildcard rules | Cluster-wide elevated access |
| `privileged: true` | Container with root-equivalent privileges |
| `run_as_user: 0` / `run_as_root: true` | Running as root |

---

## 6. Weak or Overly Broad Trust Relationships

**Description:** Trust policies or delegation configurations that allow unintended principals.

| Keywords / Attributes / Fields | Risk Signal |
|---|---|
| `trusted_entities: ["*"]` | Any entity can assume the role |
| `assume_role_policy` without condition | Unrestricted role assumption |
| `principal: { AWS: "*" }` | Any AWS account trusted |
| `federation: *` | Unrestricted identity federation |
| `cross_account_access` without external ID | Role hijacking risk |
| Missing `sts:ExternalId` condition | Confused deputy vulnerability |
| `trusted_relationship` open to all services | No service restriction |

---

## 7. Insecure Object/File Permissions

**Description:** Files, directories, or objects with overly permissive access modes.

| Keywords / Attributes / Fields | Risk Signal |
|---|---|
| `mode: 0777` / `permissions: 777` | World-readable and writable |
| `mode: 0666` | Group and world writable |
| `owner: root` with `mode: 0666` | Accessible beyond intended scope |
| `file_permission: world_writable` | Explicit world-write access |
| `umask: 000` | No permission restrictions |
| `acl: full_control` for public principal | Full access granted to all |

---

## 8. Unrestricted API / Service Endpoint Access

**Description:** API gateways, endpoints, or services without access control enforcement.

| Keywords / Attributes / Fields | Risk Signal |
|---|---|
| `cors_allowed_origins: ["*"]` | Any origin can call the API |
| `allow_credentials: true` + wildcard origin | Credential-bearing CORS bypass |
| `endpoint_type: PUBLIC` without policy | Publicly accessible endpoint |
| `private_endpoint_enabled: false` | No private network restriction |
| `ip_restriction: []` / missing IP allowlist | No IP-based access control |
| `rate_limit_enabled: false` | No throttling/access limiting |
| `usage_plan` absent | No API usage governance |

---

## 9. Missing Network Segmentation / Policies

**Description:** Absence of network-level access control definitions that restrict lateral movement.

| Keywords / Attributes / Fields | Risk Signal |
|---|---|
| Missing `network_policy` resource | No pod-to-pod traffic restriction |
| `pod_selector: {}` | Applies to all pods (default-allow) |
| Missing `namespace_selector` | Cross-namespace access not restricted |
| `default_action: allow` | Permissive default in ACLs |
| `ingress: []` / `egress: []` (absent) | No traffic rules (implicitly open) |
| Missing `security_group_id` reference | Resource not placed in a security group |

---

## 10. Disabled or Misconfigured Access Logging & Accountability

**Description:** When access logging is absent, access control violations go undetected (accountability dimension of CWE-284).

| Keywords / Attributes / Fields | Risk Signal |
|---|---|
| `logging_enabled: false` | Access logs disabled |
| `audit_log: disabled` | No audit trail |
| `enable_access_logs: false` | Load balancer/API logs off |
| `cloudtrail_enabled: false` | No API call tracking |
| `flow_logs_enabled: false` | No network-level visibility |
| Missing `log_destination` | Logs not forwarded/stored |

---

## Summary Table of Key Signals

| Category | Top Keywords |
|---|---|
| IAM Policies | `*`, `principal: "*"`, `effect: allow`, `not_action` |
| Public Exposure | `publicly_accessible`, `public-read`, `allUsers`, `block_public: false` |
| Network Rules | `0.0.0.0/0`, `::/0`, `protocol: all`, `port: 0-65535` |
| Authentication | `authorization: NONE`, `anonymous_auth`, `require_auth: false` |
| Role Assignments | `role: admin`, `system:unauthenticated`, `verbs: ["*"]` |
| Trust Relationships | `principal: "*"`, `trusted_entities: *`, missing `ExternalId` |
| File Permissions | `mode: 0777`, `permissions: 777`, `world_writable` |
| API Access | `cors: ["*"]`, `api_key_required: false`, `endpoint_type: PUBLIC` |
| Network Policies | Missing policies, `pod_selector: {}`, `default_action: allow` |
| Logging | `logging_enabled: false`, `audit_log: disabled` |

package glitch

import data.glitch_lib

value_is_wildcard(value) {
    value.ir_type == "String"
    value.value == "*"
}

value_is_wildcard(value) {
    value.ir_type == "Array"
    elem := value.value[_]
    elem.ir_type == "String"
    elem.value == "*"
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    lower(attr.name) == {"action", "actions", "resource", "resources", "principal", "principals", "not_action", "not_resource"}[_]
    value_is_wildcard(attr.value)
    result := {
        "type": "sec_invalid_bind",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Improper Access Control - Wildcard permission grants unrestricted access. (CWE-284)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    lower(attr.name) == {"cidr", "cidr_block", "cidr_blocks", "source_ranges", "source_address_prefix", "remote_ip_prefix"}[_]
    glitch_lib.traverse(attr.value, "^(?:0\\.0\\.0\\.0/0|::/0)$")
    result := {
        "type": "sec_invalid_bind",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Improper Access Control - Network rule allows traffic from any source (0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0). (CWE-284)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
